issues.title: Philippines announces bounty on senator wanted by the ICC for crime against humanity
issues.title_en: Philippines announces bounty on senator wanted by the ICC for crime against humanity
issues.summary: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine officials announced a bounty Friday for the capture of a senator who has been ordered arrested by the International Criminal Court for an alleged crime against humanity in connection with deadly anti-drugs crackdowns. The court alleges that Sen. Ronald dela Rosa, 64, was an “indirect co-conspirator”
